About the job
About Us:

Deccan AI Experts is a pioneering company founded by IIT Bombay and IIM Ahmedabad alumni, with a strong founding team from IITs, NITs, and BITS. We specialize in delivering high-quality human-curated data, AI-first scaled operations services, and more. Based in SF and Hyderabad, we are a young, fast-moving team on a mission to build AI for Good, driving innovation and positive societal impact.
About the Job:

We are looking for a skilled Back End Developer (Freelancer) to join our team and build scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems. If you're passionate about APIs, system design, and solving real-world technical challenges, this is the role for you.
Key Responsibilities:

Create deliverables addressing common backend development and system design requests.
Review peer-developed deliverables to enhance AI research and improve quality.
Design, develop, and maintain scalable server-side applications and APIs.
Diagnose and solve real-world technical issues to advance machine learning systems.
Contribute expertise to cutting-edge AI research while working independently and remotely.
Manage your own schedule with flexible hours to meet project deadlines.
Required Qualifications:

2+ years of hands-on experience in backend development or related roles.
Strong knowledge of server-side programming, APIs, and database management.
Experience in system design, performance optimization, and debugging.
Proficiency in technologies like Node.js, Django, Express.js, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Why Join Us?

Competitive pay (INR 1200/hour).
Flexible hours.
Remote opportunity.
